case.title: Vendors keeps a chosen filter after a reload
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes. No test data of its own: it uses the rows the page already lists.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Parts in the top menu opens the parts area; its left menu lists Part Sales, Inventory, Catalog, Returns, Purchase Orders, Vendor Invoices, Vendors.
  • This page has no State/Province filter button; its filter is the Search box at the right of the page header (not the search in the top bar, which searches the whole app).
case.custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Vendors in the left menu. Write down how many rows show.
  2. Click the Search box at the right of the page header (on the same line as the page title "Vendors"; not the search in the top bar).
  3. Type a vendor name from the list (e.g. the first row's name, such as "Carolina Truck & Trailer Repair") and wait for the list to update. Write down the rows shown.
  4. Reload the page.
  5. Read the Search box and the rows.
  6. Clear the Search box to put the page back as it was.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the list narrows to the rows that match what you typed.
  • After the reload the Search box still shows what you typed and the same rows show as before the reload.
  • No error message appears.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 6; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), hotspot 5; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's ruling, 9 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat, given with screenshots after we reported that this page has no filter button. Part C, word for word: “Vendors have 2 searches you can type in the page from the left sided search option to search what is on the page, and you can type something which you need globally in the application if you want to search anything else globally in the app, and there is one column button clicking which allows you to toggle enable/off the columns”. He then added, at 08:00 UTC, word for word: “Typing something in the left side page search FILTERS the page to what you need.” and, at 08:53, “" left side page search FILTERS " Sorry I meant RIGHT side search”. So the page's filter is the Search box at the right. The steps were changed to that box on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 6: “Pages that remember filters and settings: Orders, Vendors, Return Requests, Return Credits, Part Sales, Deliveries, Parts Catalogue, Inventory, and the report pages.”
  • Dev reply 6: “Set a filter, reload, and check that it's kept.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/9/2026.

changes.old_value:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as an Admin (the Admin role can see every page used below).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.

  5. At least two vendors in different states or provinces (Parts > Vendors > New Vendor if needed).
changes.new_value:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Parts in the top menu opens the parts area; its left menu lists Part Sales, Inventory, Catalog, Returns, Purchase Orders, Vendor Invoices, Vendors.
  • Needs no test data of its own beyond what the page already lists; filters you change here are restored at the end.

Setup

  1. Click Parts in the top menu > Vendors.
  2. Check the setup worked: the Vendors page lists rows. Look at the toolbar for a State/Province filter button; on build v26.40.8-7a95011 there was none.

changes.label: Steps
changes.old_value:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Vendors.
  2. Open the State/Province filter and tick one value (e.g. the first one listed). Write down the value.
  3. Close the filter and write down the rows shown.
  4. Reload the page.
changes.new_value:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Vendors in the left menu.
  2. Open the State/Province filter and tick one value (e.g. the first one listed). Write down the value.
  3. Close the filter (Escape or click outside it) and write down the rows shown.
  4. Reload the page.

  • No error message appears.
